title: Interrogation
description: The questioning layer for one trend, written by the Interrogator: provenance checks, assumption probes and a pre-mortem. The intuition prompt is not here; it lives on the Trend because it is the only question shown before the gut reading (A-4). Assumption probes are held per trend, not per reading, so that no lens receives more questioning than another. Each group is capped at three questions to protect the eight-minute budget (NF4). Every question ends with a question mark: these are questions, not advice. Shipped inside the trend's reveal bundle.
